artifactPolicy: JSON execution captures use .json.txt to preserve original bytes; authentication traces and screenshots stay private. Public logs redact capabilities; original hashes and local paths are retained.
scopeNote: sourceSha identifies the final candidate, not a retrospective assignment to every artifact. Historical failed attempts and primary-source inputs retain their own recorded source/scope. Evidence packaging does not rename the executable image.
